taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella engelmannii normalized to current accepted Physaria engelmannii.
look_here_first: Densely hairy perennial bladderpod with several stems from the base, bright yellow flowers in tight clusters, and small globose to ellipsoid fruits.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; Kew accepts Physaria engelmannii; Texas conservation sources document Edwards Plateau occurrence and diagnostic morphology.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: few to several stems from base
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The key split is perennial + dense compact flower cluster. P. densiflora is an annual; P. gracilis is more open, delicate, and spreading.
